title: MobX
description: Simple, scalable state management using observables and reactions.

data.text: MobX is a state management library that makes state management simple and scalable by applying functional reactive programming principles. It uses observables to track state changes and reactions to automatically update the UI.

data.content: Define an observable store with makeAutoObservable.

terms.definition: State that can be tracked for changes by MobX.
Side effects that automatically run when observable state changes.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: MobX provides transparent functional reactive programming for React state management.
